{{Quote|Roona seconds the motion for a vote of no confidence in Chancellor Valorum.|Edcel Bar Gane, supporting Chancellor Valorum's ouster in 32 BBY|<ref name="TPMn" />}}
'''Edcel Bar Gane''' was a [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who [[Senator/Legends|represented]] his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Roona/Legends|Roona]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], leading up to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
===Opponent of Valorum===
{{Quote|It will come down to partisanship&mdash;a contest between the factions of Bail Antilles, and those who allow Ainlee Teem to speak for them. As ever, the Core worlds will stand with Valorum; the near colonies, against.''"<br />"''He's going to polarize the senate further.|Orn Free Taa and Edcel Bar Gane, on Chancellor Valorum's passage of [[Senate Resolution BR-0371]]|<ref name="cod">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Edcel_Bar_Gane.png|thumb|left|200px|Bar Gane in formal attire.]]
Edcel Bar Gane was the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the planet [[Roona/Legends|Roona]] during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="cod" /><ref name="card">{{CCG|set=Coruscant Limited|cardname=Edcel Bar Gane}}</ref> He was assisted by an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] of the same species.<ref name="Pursuit" />

Bar Gane had voiced concerns about [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] actions and their impact on the stability of the Republic as early as [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], thinking that Valorum's ineffectiveness would further divide the politicians in extremes. During this time, Bar Gane allied himself with the influential yet corrupt Senators [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]], [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] and [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]], and was a supporter of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="cod" />

Bar Gane seconded the motion for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in the leadership of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].<ref name="card" />

===The Clone Wars===
{{Dialogue|Bar Gane|How ''dare'' they!|Paulness|They attack, and ''now'' they want peace?|Amidala|Chancellor Palpatine, may I remind the senators that the peace proposal was made ''prior'' to their assault!|Bar Gane|That only highlights its insincerity!|attr=Edcel Bar Gane, Zinn Paulness, and Padmé Amidala, on the Separatist Parliament's offer for peace negotiations|src=<ref name="Pursuit">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>}}
Bar Gane would later continue to serve as senator to Roona during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] the second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war, the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]] proposed a [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|peace negotiation]] with the Galactic Senate, However, Senators [[Gume Saam/Legends|Gume Saam]] and [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] along with [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] Representative [[Nix Card/Legends|Nix Card]] conspired with former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the public leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], to have Coruscant attacked, which was successfully carried out by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid|demolition droids]]. They [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|attacked]] the [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|Coruscant power generator]], which caused a planet-wide blackout. During a session following the attack, Bar Gane expressed anger with the Separatists' move, which fellow Senator [[Zinn Paulness/Legends|Zinn Pauless]] agreed with.

==Personality and traits==
[[File:EdcelBarGaneSenate-POP.png|thumb|right|200px|Bar Gane converses with his aide in the Senate.]]
{{Quote|And my opponents?''"<br />"''Aside from the obvious ones? The entire Ryloth group&mdash;Orn Free Taa, Connus Trell, and Chom Frey Kaa. Also Toonbuck Toora, Edcel Bar Gan [sic], Po Nudo&hellip; Do you want me to go on?|Chancellor Valorum and Senator Palpatine, on the former's [[Yinchorri embargo act]]|<ref name="Darth Plagueis (novel)">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
Bar Gane was a [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]], a green-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] similar in appearance to a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] save for his large, blue-silver oval eyes. He spoke with a sibilant voice.<ref name="cod" /> Bar Gane was surprisingly intolerant of other species,<ref name="card" /> especially in his private business sector on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

During his time on Coruscant, Bar Gane visited the [[Coruscant Opera/Legends|Coruscant Opera House]], like many other politicians of the time. Bar Gane was known to have assisted to a representation of ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]'', performed by a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] company, and shared balcony with his political allies.<ref name="cod" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|There's a Senator called Edcel Bar Gane, because an Edsel was a bargain at some point. We thought, 'George likes old cars. He's into that. He'll know what it means.'|[[Nick Dudman]]|<ref name="Databank" />}}
[[File:Roonan_Senator.png|thumb|right|200px|Edcel Bar Gane first appeared in ''The Phantom Menace''.]]
The name "Edcel Bar Gane" comes from [[Nick Dudman]], the Live Action Animatronics Effects Supervisor on [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']]. He remarked that "an [[Wikipedia:Edsel|Edsel]] was a bargain at some point", knowing that [[George Lucas]], having a passion towards old cars, would understand what it meant.

The character was voiced by [[Stephen Stanton]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.

Bar Gane has been erroneously referred to as "Edcel Bar Gan" in some sources, such as the ''Phantom Menace'' novelization by Terry Brooks.
